---
title: "Chatbot"
description: "Build a minimal synchronous Gradio ChatInterface."
---

This coding playground returns a random yes or no response through `gr.ChatInterface`. Click **Run**, send a message, and inspect the two-value response function.

```{python}
import random
import gradio as gr

def random_response(message, history):
    return random.choice(["Yes", "No"])

demo = gr.ChatInterface(random_response, type="messages", autofocus=False)

demo.launch()
```
